title: nearhunt/project/1
description: Canonical project record for NEAR Hunt. One record per project, stored on NEAR as a FastData KV value under the key `project/{source.submission_id}` in the `nearhunt.near` namespace. Versioned by the `schema` field: a future breaking change gets a new namespace (nearhunt/project/2) rather than a version field, the same approach near.social uses for post2/.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Consumers MUST check this before interpreting any other field.

id.description: Globally unique project id, formed as `{source.event}:{source.submission_id}`. Stable across re-imports, and independent of the storage key so a project can outlive its original submission.

source.description: Provenance. Who or what produced this record, and where it can be checked. Never rewritten by a later claim of ownership — a builder claiming a project adds a separate field, it does not erase where the data came from.

event.description: Identifies the originating event or dataset, e.g. `nearhackathon-2026`.

submission_id.description: The source system's own identifier for this submission. Used as the storage key, so re-importing updates rather than duplicates.

url.description: Where a human can verify this came from the source.

name.description: Project name as published by the source.

description.description: Project pitch. Null when the source does not supply one — which is the case for the NEAR Hackathon feed. Null means unknown, never empty.

tracks.description: Event tracks or categories this project belongs to, as slugs from the source. Lowercase, hyphenated. Empty array means uncategorised.

repository_url.description: Public source repository. Null when unknown; the importer never guesses this from the project name.

demo_url.description: Link demonstrating the project, usually the public demo post required by the event.

external_campaigns.description: Funding or governance campaigns elsewhere that explicitly reference this project. NEAR Hunt never custodies funds: a campaign is a validated outbound link, nothing more.

campaign_id.description: The campaign's identifier within its own system. Opaque to NEAR Hunt.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent import that touched this record. This is a property of the record, not of the project; chain position is the authority for ordering.
